usage: The word '爪' (zaau2) is used as a noun to refer to the claw of an animal.
It often appears in contexts describing animal body parts or actions involving claws.
You can use '爪' to emphasize the sharpness or the function of claws in animals.
In sentences, it can stand alone as a subject or object, such as 'The cat's claw is sharp.'
It is also common in phrases combining with verbs like 'use', 'scratch', or 'grab'.
